exact_tool_arguments.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original square head-and-shoulders portrait SOURCE CANDIDATE for the project's Harry Houdini roster owner.
Primary request: Create ONE original portrait of Harry Houdini, based ONLY on the project's accepted miniature design just shown in this conversation, art/imagegen/concept-harry-houdini-codex/design/harry-houdini-front.png. Match its original sculpted face, waved dark hair, clean-shaven look, black waistcoat, warm white shirt, gray shoulder chains and brass chest padlock. This is Harry himself, not Bess. Do not reproduce a historical photograph, film actor, commercial game illustration or avatar.
Scene/backdrop: plain uniform charcoal gray, empty.
Subject: one lean adult male escape artist, fair warm skin, angular cheekbones and jaw, straight nose, strong dark brows, attentive gray-green eyes and the accepted design's thick short dark-brown curled hair swept back with a few defined forehead curls. Clean shaven, focused composed expression. Open-neck warm ivory collared shirt and fitted stage-black waistcoat; heavy gray iron chains draped over BOTH shoulders, converging to the distinctive brass padlock on the upper chest. Show the collar, shoulders and chest padlock, with rolled sleeves only where naturally visible. No hand or other object beside the head.
Style/medium: premium hand-painted collectible tabletop MINIATURE bust, with coherent sculpted resin volumes, carefully painted facial planes and restrained brush texture, sculpted hair locks, matte cloth and worn iron with controlled brass highlights. Match the project's approved miniature craftsmanship; no photographic pores, glamour treatment or human avatar photography.
Composition/framing: square canvas, camera deliberately pulled back to a generously framed head-and-shoulders bust, near frontal and centered, both eyes clear. The bust must be small enough to leave a substantial uninterrupted charcoal band across the TOP FIFTH of the square: the highest hair point begins approximately 20 percent down from the top. Whole hair silhouette and both ears visible with ample side air. Eye line approximately 43 percent of canvas height, head width about 36 percent of canvas, shoulders inside the lower 75 percent canvas width, brass padlock centered above 85 percent height. Full100: compose for an imaginary centered circle whose diameter equals the ENTIRE square side, with no zoom or tight crop. Preserve generous top breathing room; lower outer shoulder corners may naturally lie outside that imagined circle. No pedestal or full body.
Lighting/mood: soft neutral studio key and gentle fill, readable eyes, clear face and softly lit iron links; restrained confident stage performer, no magic glow or smoke.
Color palette: accepted stage black #1C1C20, shirt white #E6E2D8, iron #5C6064, brass padlock #C2963E, natural fair skin and dark brown hair.
Constraints: one original portrait only, preserve accepted project identity and miniature materials. Entire head with generous margins. No clipping, text, lettering, logo, watermark, frame, medallion, badge, circular mask, UI, card layout, collage, top hat, moustache, facial hair, weapons, extra characters or copied commercial artwork.

reference_use: Own accepted 1a design opened through view_image immediately before preflight/generation, then described in prompt as context reference. No referenced_image_paths or num_last_images_to_include arguments; this was new source generation, not an edit/crop. No commercial or avatar images opened.

output.source_pixel_processing: none; no resize, crop, retouch, recolor or recompression of original/selected PNG

diagnostic_previews.crop: full100; centered circle diameter 100% of square side, zero zoom
diagnostic_previews.method: Lanczos resampling of entire square; antialiased circular diagnostic mask on light-gray matte. 320 grayscale also provided. These derivative review images do not replace or modify source PNGs.
diagnostic_previews.inspection: Selected saved PNG and full100-review-sheet.png opened with view_image; 80/40 viewed at native tile sizes within sheet. Runtime widget not tested.

self_review.identity: Clean-shaven angular face, dark sculpted waved curls, ivory open-collar shirt, black waistcoat, shoulder chains and brass padlock follow the accepted Houdini design. Expression is calmer and facial modeling somewhat softer/younger than the 1a figure; identity is an original design interpretation, not an exact face transfer. No Bess substitution.
self_review.craftsmanship: Coherent sculpted locks, chain links, padlock and painted cloth texture support the miniature bust style. Skin is smooth and comparatively naturalistic; source-only candidate, not claimed as a scanned or rendered physical miniature.
self_review.background: Plain charcoal with a slight tonal gradient; no scenery, lettering, UI, frame or watermark seen. Not numerically uniform.
self_review.source_framing: Whole hair silhouette and both ears retained. Top margin is visually about 20%, eye line near 44%, with centered visible eyes. Chains and full brass padlock visible; lower torso naturally exits bottom of square.
self_review.circular_full100: Centered circle diameter 100% of square preserves hair, ears, face and padlock. Lower outer shoulder/sleeve edges are clipped by circle, as expected. Padlock sits near lower arc; tighter crops could remove its bottom. Keep full100 with no zoom.
self_review.native_80: Hair, face and broad chain/padlock motif read; small link detail is reduced.
self_review.native_40: Face becomes very small because generous headroom is retained; individual eyes, expression and chain link geometry do not reliably resolve. Brass lock is a tiny accent. No alternate zoom/crop was substituted.
limits: At 40 px the small centered head and eyes have limited readability.
Padlock lies close to bottom circle arc; shoulders and rolled sleeves are partly cropped.
Softer/calmer generated face differs subtly from the stern 1a sculpt.
No runtime widget, DPI, interaction state or independent review tested.

scope: Manual files only inside this assigned new character subfolder. Built-in image tool automatic output left at default Codex path. No git mutation, shared/package-root file edits, registry/ledger/code changes, imports, paid external calls or subagents.
processes: All shell, Python and read-only psql commands finished; no background process or service was started.
